title: Matthew Brown snuck into secret congressional briefing

tellings.quote: Um I snuck him in, you know, to have a secret congressional briefing with three members who all said yes to me.

plain: Sometime between 2024 and 2026, the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says he quietly brought a man named Matthew Brown into a secret briefing in Washington with three members of Congress. Corbell says all three lawmakers had agreed to meet when he asked. He tells it himself, as the person who arranged it, in a 2026 episode.
